findings.location: #s3-wizard, <div class="wizard-steps"> container with CSS order property, lines 47-57
findings.evidence: Step elements in DOM order: #s3-step3 (order:3), #s3-step2 (order:2), #s3-step1 (order:1); CSS order property visually reverses to 1, 2, 3
findings.violation: The DOM reading order (confirm, payment, choose) does not match the visual and logical task order (choose, payment, confirm), reversing the correct sequence for screen-reader users
findings.fix: Reorder the DOM elements so step1, step2, step3 appear in that sequence in the markup, or remove CSS order property and rely on correct DOM order

findings.evidence: Label text displays in red color (#cc0000) with no asterisk, aria-required attribute, or other non-color visual indicator
findings.violation: Red color alone signals this field as required or different from others, with no accompanying text label, icon, or other non-color signal carrying the same meaning
findings.fix: Add an asterisk or "required" text after the label, add aria-required="true" to the input element, or add required attribute to the input

findings.evidence: Error text reads "Error." with no identification of which field is invalid or what the problem is
findings.violation: Error message is too generic and does not describe the specific validation failure, leaving the user unable to determine how to correct the input
findings.fix: Replace with specific error description such as "Invalid promo code format" or "Promo code not found"

findings.evidence: Div element with class icon-delete contains only a trash-icon image with empty alt text; no role, aria-label, aria-labelledby, or title attribute
findings.violation: Custom control exposes no programmatic role, accessible name, or state, making the control undetectable and its purpose unintelligible to screen-reader users
findings.fix: Add role="button" (or role="img" if decorative), add aria-label="Delete", ensure keyboard accessibility with appropriate event handlers, and expose state with aria-pressed or similar when applicable
